description: Returns live French website pricing data from the Les Créavores open dataset (prices publicly displayed by web agencies and freelancers): one cell per 'type|unit' (e.g. 'vitrine|forfait', 'maintenance|mensuel') with sample size n, number of distinct providers and p10/p25/p50/p75/p90 in euros. Optional filters by type and unit; only publishable cells are returned by default. Every answer carries source, licence, generation date and citation.

include_unpublishable.description: Also return cells flagged publiable=false (default false)

type.description: Site/service type as written in the dataset, e.g. vitrine, e-commerce, one_page, seo, maintenance

unit.description: Pricing unit as written in the dataset, e.g. forfait (one-off) or mensuel (monthly)

name: get_prix_site
